prompt: What does the host say about puzzle sheets picked up earlier in the week?
promptZh: 主持人怎麼說本週稍早已領取的題紙？

options.text: They should be traded at the main desk.
options.whyZh: 講者沒有要求換題紙，之前領的在會堂也能用。

options.text: They must be saved for the next outdoor meeting.
options.zh: 必須留到下一次戶外聚會使用。
options.whyZh: 這週改到會堂也可以用，無須留到下次。

options.text: They can be used in the hall.
options.whyZh: 已領戶外場次題紙的人帶原本那張即可。

options.text: They contain the wrong starting time.
options.zh: 上面寫的開始時間不對。
options.whyZh: 開始時間還是十點；講者沒有說題紙印了錯誤時間。

explanationZh: 已領戶外場次題紙的人帶原本那張即可。
evidence: If you picked up an outdoor sheet earlier this week, you can use it in the hall too.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If you picked up an outdoor sheet earlier this week, you can use it in the hall too.

vocabulary.note: 此處指先前拿取活動用的題目單。
